# Gamato Piranti

> Suite alat digital berbasis browser: QR code & barcode, PDF, dokumen Office, gambar, video, audio, utilitas, dan dokumen bisnis. Semua file diproses langsung di perangkat pengguna — tidak ada unggahan ke server, tanpa akun, gratis.

## Kategori alat

- [QR & Barcode Studio](https://gamatopiranti.zone.id/qr): QR code kustom, barcode multi-format, pemindai QR
- [PDF Lab](https://gamatopiranti.zone.id/pdf): gabung, pecah, kompres, konversi Office ⇄ PDF, OCR, tanda tangan, proteksi
- [Office Tools](https://gamatopiranti.zone.id/office): Doc Studio, Sheet Studio, Slide Studio, Diagram & Rumus
- [Image Lab](https://gamatopiranti.zone.id/image): editor foto, kolase, hapus background, kompres, konversi
- [Video Studio](https://gamatopiranti.zone.id/video): konversi, kompres, potong, crop, subtitle, gabung
- [Audio Studio](https://gamatopiranti.zone.id/audio): konversi, edit, transkrip, speech to text, text to speech
- [Rak Utilitas](https://gamatopiranti.zone.id/utility): kalkulator, universal converter, kamus dunia, JSON, Base64
- [Spesial](https://gamatopiranti.zone.id/special): invoice, kwitansi, kartu nama, sertifikat, CV, name tag
